comment: SAM-dependent N-methyltransferase of AT2433 biosynthesis. Methylates the imide nitrogen of arcyriaflavin A and its N-glucosides.

reactions.description: N-methylation of the imide nitrogen of an indolocarbazole (arcyriaflavin A or its N-glucoside)
N-methylation of rebeccamycin to its N-methyl derivative (38% yield)
N-methylation of arcyriaflavin A, the aglycon without sugar (12% yield)
